pro red_check_archive, year = year, instrument = instrument, files = files, skipfiles = skipfiles outfile = 'red_check_archive.out' goodfile = 'red_check_archive.good' if n_elements(skipfiles) eq 0 then skipfiles = '' if n_elements(year) eq 0 then year = '????' else begin outfile = 'red_check_archive_'+year+'.out' goodfile = 'red_check_archive_'+year+'.good' endelse ;; Read list of already checked files if file_test(goodfile) then spawn, 'cat '+goodfile, goodfiles else goodfiles = '' if n_elements(instrument) eq 0 then instrument = '*' if n_elements(files) eq 0 then begin dirs = '/storage/science_data/'+strtrim(year, 2)+'-??-??/'+instrument+'/' files = file_search(dirs+'*.fits', count = Nfiles) endif else begin Nfiles = n_elements(files) dirs = red_uniquify(file_dirname(files), count = Ndirs) if Ndirs gt 1 then begin print, 'Only a single dir if using files keyword' return endif endelse if file_test(outfile) then openu, lun, outfile, /get_lun else openw, lun, outfile, /get_lun if Nfiles eq 0 then begin print, 'No data from '+year printf, lun, 'No data from '+year free_lun, lun return endif for ifile = 0, Nfiles-1 do begin file = file_basename(files[ifile]) ;; Skip flipped cubes if strmatch(file, '*_sp.fits') then continue print print, file dir = file_dirname(files[ifile]) outstrings = ['', dir, file] print_outstrings = 0 if n_elements(goodfiles) gt 0 && round(total(goodfiles eq file)) gt 0 then begin print, 'Already checked' continue endif if round(total(skipfiles eq file)) gt 0 then begin print, 'Skip this file' red_append, outstrings, 'Had to skip this file' print_outstrings = 1 endif else begin stokes_in_name = strmatch(file, '*stokes*') mos_in_name = strmatch(file, '*mosaic*') splt = strsplit(file, '_', /extract) filter_in_name = splt[1] time_in_name = splt[2] date_in_name = (strsplit(time_in_name, 'T', /extract))[0] this_is_wb = splt[0] eq 'wb' splt = strsplit(dir, '/', /extract) instrument_in_dir = splt[-1] date_in_dir = splt[-2] hdr = headfits(files[ifile], errmsg = errmsg, /silent) if errmsg ne '' then begin stop red_append, outstrings, errmsg endif time_in_hdr = strtrim(fxpar(hdr, 'DATE-OBS'), 2) date_in_hdr = (strsplit(time_in_hdr, 'T', /extract))[0] instrument_in_hdr = strtrim(fxpar(hdr, 'INSTRUME'), 2) stokes_in_hdr = fxpar(hdr, 'NAXIS4') eq 4 filename_in_hdr = strtrim(fxpar(hdr, 'FILENAME'), 2) filter_in_hdr = strtrim(fxpar(hdr, 'FILTER1'), 2) if mos_in_name then begin naxis = fxpar(hdr, 'NAXIS*') if max(naxis[0:1]) lt 3000 then begin ;; Mosaics should have a FOV larger than a single frame print, 'Mosaic mismatch' print, 'NAXIS1 : ', naxis[0] print, 'NAXIS2 : ', naxis[1] red_append, outstrings, 'Mosaic mismatch' red_append, outstrings, 'NAXIS1 : '+ strtrim(naxis[0], 2) red_append, outstrings, 'NAXIS2 : '+ strtrim(naxis[1], 2) print_outstrings = 1 endif endif if (stokes_in_hdr ne stokes_in_name) && ~this_is_wb then begin print, 'Stokes mismatch' print, 'NAXIS4 : '+strtrim(fxpar(hdr, 'NAXIS4'), 2) red_append, outstrings, 'Stokes mismatch' red_append, outstrings, 'NAXIS4 : '+strtrim(fxpar(hdr, 'NAXIS4'), 2) print_outstrings = 1 endif if date_in_hdr ne date_in_name then begin print, 'Date mismatch' print, 'hdr : ' + date_in_hdr red_append, outstrings, 'Date mismatch' red_append, outstrings, 'hdr : ' + date_in_hdr print_outstrings = 1 endif if instrument_in_hdr ne instrument_in_dir then begin print, 'Instrument mismatch' print, 'hdr : ' + instrument_in_hdr print, 'dir : ' + instrument_in_dir red_append, outstrings, 'Instrument mismatch' red_append, outstrings, 'hdr : ' + instrument_in_hdr red_append, outstrings, 'dir : ' + instrument_in_dir print_outstrings = 1 endif if strmid(filename_in_hdr,0,1,/reverse) eq '&' then begin print, 'Header CONTINUE problem' print, filename_in_hdr red_append, outstrings, 'Header CONTINUE problem' red_append, outstrings, filename_in_hdr print_outstrings = 1 endif if ~strmatch(file_basename(file, '.fits'), file_basename(filename_in_hdr, '.fits')+'*') $ && ~strmatch(file_basename(file, '.fits'), file_basename(filename_in_hdr, '_im.fits')+'*') then begin print, 'Filename mismatch' print, filename_in_hdr red_append, outstrings, 'Filename mismatch' red_append, outstrings, filename_in_hdr print_outstrings = 1 endif if filter_in_hdr ne filter_in_name then begin print, 'Filter mismatch' print, filter_in_hdr red_append, outstrings, 'Filter mismatch' red_append, outstrings, filter_in_hdr print_outstrings = 1 endif ;; Test reading some data naxis = fxpar(hdr, 'NAXIS*') red_fitscube_getframe, files[ifile], frame, iframe = 0 red_fitscube_getframe, files[ifile], frame, iframe = long(product(naxis[2:*])-1) print, file_basename(files[ifile]) ;; Test reading WCS info if this_is_wb then begin red_fitscube_getwcs, files[ifile], coordinates=coordinates endif else begin red_fitscube_getwcs, files[ifile], coordinates=coordinates, distortions=distortions distortions=0 endelse endelse if print_outstrings then printf, lun, outstrings, format = '(a0)' red_append, goodfiles, file openw, glun, goodfile, /get_lun printf, glun, goodfiles, format = '(a0)' free_lun, glun endfor ; ifile free_lun, lun end ; ;files = '/storage/science_data/2024-06-17/CRISP/' $ ; + ['nb_6563_2024-06-04T07:09:32_mosaic_0--14_stokes_corrected.fits' $ ; , 'nb_6563_2024-06-04T08:41:07_mosaic_0--14_stokes_corrected.fits' $ ; , 'nb_6563_2024-06-04T09:26:27_mosaic_0--14_stokes_corrected.fits'] ; ;red_check_archive, files = files ; ;stop ;year = '2024' instrument = 'CRISP' skipfiles = ['nb_5173_2020-10-11T08:04:16_scans=0-53_corrected_export2021-06-07T16:23:19_im.fits' $ , 'nb_5173_2020-10-11T09:16:47_scans=0-16_corrected_export2021-06-07T22:13:39_im.fits' $ , 'nb_6563_2020-10-11T08:04:16_scans=0-53_corrected_export2021-06-07T16:24:33_im.fits' $ , 'nb_6563_2020-10-11T09:16:47_scans=0-16_corrected_export2021-06-07T22:14:42_im.fits' $ , 'wb_5173_2020-10-11T08:04:16_scans=0-53_corrected_export2021-06-07T16:23:19_im.fits' $ , 'wb_5173_2020-10-11T09:16:47_scans=0-16_corrected_export2021-06-07T22:13:39_im.fits' $ , 'wb_6563_2020-10-11T08:04:16_scans=0-53_corrected_export2021-06-07T16:24:33_im.fits' $ , 'wb_6563_2020-10-11T09:16:47_scans=0-16_corrected_export2021-06-07T22:14:42_im.fits' $ , 'wb_8542_2020-10-11T08:04:16_scans=0-53_corrected_export2021-06-07T16:25:32_im.fits' $ , 'wb_8542_2020-10-11T09:16:47_scans=0-16_corrected_export2021-06-07T22:15:50_im.fits' $ ] red_check_archive, year = year, instrument = instrument, skipfiles = skipfiles end
